Title: Amulet of Temporal Perception - Burning and Reuse

Messages.Author: Killiam
Messages.Body:
If you use the Amulet of Temporal Perception and then burn it and bring out another copy, can you use that newly-equipped Amulet on that same turn, or are you prohibited by card text?

Thanks much!!
-Bill / Killiam

Name: Amulet of Temporal Perception
[HttB:R/B1]
Cardtype: Equipment
Unique.
This vampire can burn 1 blood to play a card requiring basic Temporis [tem] from your hand. This equipment can be used only once each turn.
Artist: Nicolas Bigot

-Killiam
(Bill Troxel)  "I look back from where I'm from
Look at the woman I've become
And the strangest things seem
Suddenly routine"

Messages.Author: KoRneeshon
Messages.Body: I think you can, just like a sawed-off shotgun, that is usable only once each combat, but if you have two, you can use both (in separate strikes, of course).

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> KoRneeshon wrote:
> I think you can, just like a sawed-off shotgun, that is usable only once each combat, but if you have two, you can use both (in separate strikes, of course).
